About Agent Built

Agent Built is a working notebook from someone shipping software with AI agents in 2026. Not a course. Not a newsletter that sells you the course. A place where the things that work get written down so other people building can use them.

What we cover

  • How to integrate Claude, ChatGPT, and other agents with the rest of your stack — n8n, Make, Zapier, custom code.
  • What we tried, what worked, what didn't, with the receipts.
  • Specific pricing, scaling, and tooling tradeoffs (because nobody is publishing the actual numbers).
  • Tools we've built ourselves — when relevant, when honest.

How posts get written

Some posts on Agent Built are co-written with AI agents. We think it would be weird to run an "Agent Built" blog and pretend otherwise. The pipeline: we pick a topic, the agent does the research (real sources, real benchmarks), drafts a post, and a human reads every word before it goes live. Nothing here is unreviewed. We tell you this because the alternative is dishonest.

Who's behind it

Operated by a software engineer / operator running multiple AI-product experiments in public. We're not selling a $1,997 course. If a post is paid placement we'll say so inline.
